branch.name: Personal Productivity
branch.summary: Personal and work organization: calendars (Google Calendar, Outlook/Microsoft 365, Apple Calendar) including events, invites and free/busy; to-do lists and reminders (Todoist, Microsoft To Do, Apple Reminders); contacts; time-zone conversion; and personal notes (Apple Notes, Obsidian).

toolkits.name: Google Calendar
toolkits.summary: List, search, create, update and delete Google Calendar events, respond to invites, and query free/busy.

tools.name: list_calendars
tools.description: List all available calendars

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List events from one or more calendars.

calendarId.description: ID of the calendar(s) to list events from. Accepts either a single calendar ID string or an array of calendar IDs

timeZone.description: IANA time zone to interpret times in, e.g. America/Los_Angeles. Defaults to the calendar's time zone.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of events to return

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search for events in a calendar by text query.

calendarId.description: ID of the calendar (use 'primary' for the main calendar)

query.description: Free text search query (searches summary, description, location, attendees, etc.)

tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Create a new calendar event.

calendarId.description: ID of the calendar (use 'primary' for the main calendar)

start.description: Date-time in ISO 8601 format, e.g. 2026-10-14T15:00:00 (timezone offset optional when timeZone is set)

end.description: Date-time in ISO 8601 format, e.g. 2026-10-14T15:00:00 (timezone offset optional when timeZone is set)

timeZone.description: IANA time zone for start/end, e.g. Europe/London

addGoogleMeet.description: Attach a Google Meet video conference link

useDefault.description: Whether to use the default reminders

minutes.description: Minutes before the event to trigger the reminder

transparency.description: Whether the event blocks time on the calendar

sendUpdates.description: Whether to send invitations to attendees

tools.name: update_event
tools.description: Update an existing calendar event with recurring event modification scope support.

calendarId.description: ID of the calendar (use 'primary' for the main calendar)

eventId.description: ID of the event to update

start.description: Date-time in ISO 8601 format, e.g. 2026-10-14T15:00:00 (timezone offset optional when timeZone is set)

end.description: Date-time in ISO 8601 format, e.g. 2026-10-14T15:00:00 (timezone offset optional when timeZone is set)

originalStartTime.description: Original start time of the instance being modified (required when scope is 'thisEventOnly')

tools.name: delete_event
tools.description: Delete a calendar event.

calendarId.description: ID of the calendar (use 'primary' for the main calendar)

eventId.description: ID of the event to delete

tools.name: get_freebusy
tools.description: Query free/busy information for calendars. Note: Time range is limited to a maximum of 3 months between timeMin and timeMax.

id.description: ID of the calendar or a user's email address

calendars.description: List of calendars and/or groups to query for free/busy information

timeMin.description: The start of the interval for the query (ISO 8601)

timeMax.description: The end of the interval for the query (ISO 8601)

timeZone.description: Time zone used in the response

groupExpansionMax.description: Maximal number of calendars for which FreeBusy information is to be provided for a single group (max 100)

calendarExpansionMax.description: Maximal number of calendars for which FreeBusy information is to be provided (max 50)

tools.name: respond_to_event
tools.description: Respond to a calendar event invitation with Accept, Decline, Maybe (tentative), or No Response.

calendarId.description: ID of the calendar (use 'primary' for the main calendar)

eventId.description: ID of the event to respond to

comment.description: Optional message to include with your response

toolkits.name: Microsoft 365 (Outlook Calendar, To Do, Contacts)
toolkits.summary: Microsoft Graph access to the Outlook calendar (events, availability, meeting-time suggestions), Microsoft To Do tasks and Outlook contacts.

tools.name: get_calendar_view
tools.description: Get the occurrences, exceptions, and single instances of events in a calendar view defined by a time range, from the user's default calendar.

startDateTime.description: The start date and time of the time range, in ISO 8601 format

endDateTime.description: The end date and time of the time range, in ISO 8601 format

tools.name: create_calendar_event
tools.description: Create an event in the user's default calendar or specified calendar.

calendarId.description: Calendar ID (omit for the default calendar)

timeZone.description: Windows or IANA time zone, e.g. 'Pacific Standard Time'
Windows or IANA time zone, e.g. 'Pacific Standard Time'

isOnlineMeeting.description: Create an online meeting for the event

reminderMinutesBeforeStart.description: Minutes before start to remind the user

tools.name: update_calendar_event
tools.description: Update the properties of the event object.

timeZone.description: Windows or IANA time zone, e.g. 'Pacific Standard Time'
Windows or IANA time zone, e.g. 'Pacific Standard Time'

isOnlineMeeting.description: Create an online meeting for the event

reminderMinutesBeforeStart.description: Minutes before start to remind the user

tools.name: delete_calendar_event
tools.description: Removes the specified event from the containing calendar.

tools.name: find_meeting_times
tools.description: Suggest meeting times and locations based on organizer and attendee availability, and time or location constraints specified as parameters. If findMeetingTimes cannot return any meeting suggestions, the response would indicate a reason in the emptySuggestionsReason property.

attendees.description: Attendees or resources for the meeting

timeZone.description: Windows or IANA time zone, e.g. 'Pacific Standard Time'
Windows or IANA time zone, e.g. 'Pacific Standard Time'

meetingDuration.description: Length of the meeting as ISO 8601 duration, e.g. PT1H

maxCandidates.description: Maximum number of suggestions to return

isOrganizerOptional.description: Whether the organizer has to attend

returnSuggestionReasons.description: Return a reason for each suggestion

minimumAttendeePercentage.description: Minimum required confidence for a time slot to be returned (0-100)

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Get the free/busy availability information for a collection of users, distributions lists, or resources (rooms or equipment) for a specified time period.

schedules.description: SMTP addresses of users, distribution lists, or resources to get availability for

timeZone.description: Windows or IANA time zone, e.g. 'Pacific Standard Time'
Windows or IANA time zone, e.g. 'Pacific Standard Time'

availabilityViewInterval.description: Duration of a time slot in minutes (5-1440)

tools.name: list_todo_tasks
tools.description: List tasks in a To Do list.

todoTaskListId.description: ID of the task list (use list name lookup if unknown)

tools.name: create_todo_task
tools.description: Create a new task in a specified Microsoft To Do task list.

timeZone.description: Windows or IANA time zone, e.g. 'Pacific Standard Time'

isReminderOn.description: Whether a reminder alert is set

timeZone.description: Windows or IANA time zone, e.g. 'Pacific Standard Time'

tools.name: list_outlook_contacts
tools.description: List contacts

$search.description: Search contacts by name or email

toolkits.name: Todoist
toolkits.summary: Create, find, update and complete Todoist tasks and projects.

tools.name: add_tasks
tools.description: Add one or more tasks to a project, section, or parent.

content.description: The task name/title. Should be concise and actionable.

description.description: Additional details, notes, or context for the task.

priority.description: Task priority: p1 (highest), p2 (high), p3 (medium), p4 (lowest/default)

dueString.description: Natural language due date like 'tomorrow', 'next Friday', 'every Monday at 9am'

projectId.description: The project ID to add this task to

sectionId.description: The section ID to add this task to

responsibleUser.description: Assign task to this user (ID, name or email). Shared projects only.

tasks.description: The array of tasks to add.

tools.name: find_tasks
tools.description: Find tasks by text search, or by project/section/parent container/responsible user. At least one filter must be provided.

searchText.description: The text to search for in tasks.

parentId.description: Find subtasks of this parent task.

responsibleUser.description: Find tasks assigned to this user.

limit.description: The maximum number of tasks to return.

cursor.description: The cursor to get the next page of tasks.

tools.name: find_tasks_by_date
tools.description: Get tasks by date range. Use startDate 'today' to get today's tasks including overdue items, or provide a specific date/date range.

startDate.description: The start date to get the tasks for. Format: YYYY-MM-DD or 'today'.

daysCount.description: The number of days to get the tasks for, starting from the start date.

limit.description: The maximum number of tasks to return.

responsibleUser.description: Only tasks assigned to this user

tools.name: update_tasks
tools.description: Update existing tasks including content, dates, priorities, and assignments.

id.description: The ID of the task to update.

dueString.description: New due date in natural language; 'no date' clears it

projectId.description: Move the task to this project

sectionId.description: Move the task to this section

tools.name: complete_tasks
tools.description: Complete one or more tasks by their IDs.

ids.description: The IDs of the tasks to complete.

tools.name: find_projects
tools.description: List all projects or search for projects by name.

search.description: Search for a project by name (partial and case insensitive match). If omitted, all projects are returned.

limit.description: The maximum number of projects to return.

tools.name: add_projects
tools.description: Add one or more new projects.

parentId.description: The ID of the parent project, for a sub-project.

isFavorite.description: Whether the project is a favorite.

projects.description: The array of projects to add.

toolkits.name: Apple (Contacts, Notes, Reminders, Calendar)
toolkits.summary: Access the macOS Contacts, Notes, Reminders and Calendar apps on the user's Mac.

tools.name: contacts
tools.description: Search and retrieve contacts from Apple Contacts app

name.description: Name to search for (optional - if not provided, returns all contacts). Can be partial name to search.

tools.name: notes
tools.description: Search, retrieve and create notes in Apple Notes app

searchText.description: Text to search for in notes (required for search operation)

title.description: Title of the note to create (required for create operation)

body.description: Content of the note to create (required for create operation)

folderName.description: Name of the folder to create the note in (optional for create operation, defaults to 'Claude')

tools.name: reminders
tools.description: Search, create, and open reminders in Apple Reminders app

searchText.description: Text to search for in reminders (required for search and open operations)

name.description: Name of the reminder to create (required for create operation)

listName.description: Name of the list to create the reminder in (optional for create operation)

listId.description: ID of the list to get reminders from (required for listById operation)

props.description: Properties to include in the reminders (optional for listById operation)

notes.description: Additional notes for the reminder (optional for create operation)

dueDate.description: Due date for the reminder in ISO format (optional for create operation)

tools.name: calendar
tools.description: Search, create, and open calendar events in Apple Calendar app

searchText.description: Text to search for in event titles, locations, and notes (required for search operation)

eventId.description: ID of the event to open (required for open operation)

limit.description: Number of events to retrieve (optional, default 10)

fromDate.description: Start date for search range in ISO format (optional, default is today)

toDate.description: End date for search range in ISO format (optional, default is 30 days from now for search, 7 days for list)

title.description: Title of the event to create (required for create operation)

startDate.description: Start date/time of the event in ISO format (required for create operation)

endDate.description: End date/time of the event in ISO format (required for create operation)

location.description: Location of the event (optional for create operation)

notes.description: Additional notes for the event (optional for create operation)

isAllDay.description: Whether the event is an all-day event (optional for create operation, default is false)

calendarName.description: Name of the calendar to create the event in (optional for create operation, uses default calendar if not specified)

toolkits.name: Time
toolkits.summary: Current time and time-zone conversions using IANA time zone names.

tools.name: get_current_time
tools.description: Get current time in a specific timezones

timezone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London'). Use 'UTC' as local timezone if no timezone provided by the user.

tools.name: convert_time
tools.description: Convert time between timezones

source_timezone.description: Source IANA timezone name (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London'). Use 'UTC' as local timezone if no source timezone provided by the user.

target_timezone.description: Target IANA timezone name (e.g., 'Asia/Tokyo', 'America/San_Francisco'). Use 'UTC' as local timezone if no target timezone provided by the user.

toolkits.name: Obsidian
toolkits.summary: Read, search and edit notes in an Obsidian vault via the Local REST API plugin.

tools.name: obsidian_simple_search
tools.description: Simple search for documents matching a specified text query across all files in the vault. Use this tool when you want to do a simple text search

query.description: Text to a simple search for in the vault.

context_length.description: How much context to return around the matching string (default: 100)

tools.name: obsidian_get_file_contents
tools.description: Return the content of a single file in your vault.

filepath.description: Path to the relevant file (relative to your vault root).

tools.name: obsidian_list_files_in_dir
tools.description: Lists all files and directories that exist in a specific Obsidian directory.

dirpath.description: Path to list files from (relative to your vault root). Note that empty directories will not be returned.

tools.name: obsidian_append_content
tools.description: Append content to a new or existing file in the vault.

filepath.description: Path to the file (relative to vault root)

content.description: Content to append to the file

tools.name: obsidian_patch_content
tools.description: Insert content into an existing note relative to a heading, block reference, or frontmatter field.

filepath.description: Path to the file (relative to vault root)

operation.description: Operation to perform (append, prepend, or replace)

target.description: Target identifier (heading path like 'Ideas' or 'Projects::Garden', block reference, or frontmatter field)

tools.name: obsidian_get_periodic_note
tools.description: Get current periodic note for the specified period.

period.description: The period type (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, yearly)
